mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the dissolved in dilute buffered saline stored frozen.
The product is the dissolved in dilute buffered saline stored frozen.
Fill in the blank: ______ are known as nucleoproteins, and these can be separated into the component proteins and nucleic acids by treatment with acid or high salt concentration.
The nucleic acid-protein complexes are known as nucleoproteins, and these can be separated into the component proteins and nucleic acids by treatment with acid or high salt concentration.
Fill in the blank: ______ are one of the most important components in many foods.
Carbohydrates are one of the most important components in many foods.
Fill in the blank: ______ is defined as the ratio of the volume of solute to the total volume of solute plus solvent, multiplied by.
Volume percentage is defined as the ratio of the volume of solute to the total volume of solute plus solvent, multiplied by 100.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a total amount of acid in the solution as determined by the titratable using a standard solution of sodium hydroxide (titrant).
Titratable acidity is a total amount of acid in the solution as determined by the titratable using a standard solution of sodium hydroxide (titrant).
fib: ______ is a solution of known concentration.
A standard solution is a solution of known concentration.
______ is the amount of glucose (sugar) in the blood expressed as millimoles per litre (mmol/l).blood glucose should have a range of 4-8mmol/l.
The blood sugar level is the amount of glucose (sugar) in the blood expressed as millimoles per litre (mmol/l).blood glucose should have a range of 4-8mmol/l.
______ is defined as the number of grams of solute per one hundred cm3 of solution multiplied by.
Weight/volume percentage is defined as the number of grams of solute per one hundred cm3 of solution multiplied by 100.
______ is defined as the ratio of the weight of solute to the total weight of solute plus solvent multiplied by.
Weight percentage is defined as the ratio of the weight of solute to the total weight of solute plus solvent multiplied by 100.
______ is a term to describe acid such as phosphoric acid, sulfuric which are involve in renal physiology.
Titratable acid is a term to describe acid such as phosphoric acid, sulfuric which are involve in renal physiology.

Concentration is a physical quantity which we measured in quantitative chemical analysis of mixtures.
